newsitem.title: UK: Azlan says Adrian Lamb resigns from board.
newsitem.headline: Azlan says Adrian Lamb resigns from board.

text.p: British computing products and services distributor Azlan Group Plc said on Tuesday that Adrian Lamb has resigned from the board of directors.

The company, whose share price was suspended last Friday because to "unresolved accounting issues", said in a statement that Lamb would continue to work with the new finance director Peter Bertram and the firm's auditors "in order to assist in the resolution of the accounting issues identified".
Lamb previously held the position of finance director until being replaced by Bertram in April of this year.
Last Friday the group said that publication of its annual results, originally scheduled for June 26, will be delayed as a result of the investigation into the accounting issues.
